We want you to absolutely love your Abbott Lyon jewellery! If it’s not quite right, here’s how our return and refund policy works:

You’ve got 1 year to return most non-personalised items, starting from the day you purchased them. Just make sure the items are in their original condition with packaging intact.
Earrings can only be returned once per customer per year.
Gift packaging, greeting cards, e-gift cards, and Advent Calendars are non-returnable.

For custom and personalised items:

These can only be exchanged for store credit within 30 days of delivery—refunds aren’t available for these pieces.
Only one exchange per original order is allowed.
